description: Keep evolving against a producer that never sends an end-of-stream item.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A population of calibration vectors is maintained while measurements arrive.; fitness_evaluation: fitness compares each vector sum with the current measurement.; selection: adapt selects the lowest-error vectors.; replacement: The selected vectors form a replacement pool with a derived candidate.. Negative-role rationale: The derived candidate adds a constant to its parent and does not mutate an existing gene or combine two parents; there is no stop condition. Safety behavior: The queue read blocks indefinitely if no measurement arrives, and the outer loop has no termination path. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats hard unbounded-loop or recursion-without-base findings as UNSAFE.
